what: Seeder is planned as a pre-wrapper Python call even though the load-bearing 3.11 JSON fallback only runs inside step-8-ship.sh
scenario_or_breakage: With Python <3.11, python/cli.py ship seed-initial-state exits 2 on stderr before the wrapper runs, so Step 8 no longer receives the required STALLED JSON fallback
suggested_fix: Do not run the ship seeder before the wrapper guard; either move Step 8 seeding into step-8-ship.sh after its version check or add an equivalent Bash-level 3.11 JSON fallback before the seeder
